findings.issue: download_pdf signature accepts download_root as str|Path, but the default is a relative string 'data/downloads'. If CWD changes at runtime (e.g. Streamlit changes working directory), downloads go to wrong location.
findings.suggestion: Derive download_root as an absolute path from __file__ or accept it always as an absolute Path from the caller (queue_processor).

findings.issue: _call_with_backoff wraps downloader.next_chunk in a lambda and retries it on rate limit, but MediaIoBaseDownload.next_chunk is stateful — retrying a chunk after partial download may corrupt the buffer.
findings.suggestion: Apply backoff only to service.files().list() and service.files().get_media() calls, not to downloader.next_chunk(). For chunk download errors, restart the download from scratch.

findings.issue: cache_discovery=False disables caching of the API discovery document. This adds latency on every get_service() call. Acceptable for a local tool but worth noting.
findings.suggestion: No change required. Avoids stale cached discovery docs.
